description_en: Sets the call forwarding number for a 400 number
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi set-transfer-callee-pool-config --details Called=15100000000 Caller=15000000000 --phone-number 4009030000 --qualification-id 190000 --called-route-mode roundRobin --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetTransferCalleePoolConfig

fields.help_en:
The called number. The number must be registered.

You can call the SubmitHotlineTransferRegister (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-submithotlinetransferregister) operation to submit a number registration
fields.help_zh:
被叫号码。已备案的号码。

您可以通过SubmitHotlineTransferRegister (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-submithotlinetransferregister?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7b784120BH0XPT)接口，提交号码备案
fields.name: called

parameters.help_en:
The call forwarding number.

The 400 number that you purchased on the Real Number Management page of the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/number/list/400)
parameters.help_zh:
呼转号码。

您已在语音服务控制台真实号码管理页面 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/number/list/400)购买的400号码
parameters.name: phone_number

parameters.help_en: The qualification ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/393548.html operation to obtain the qualification ID
parameters.name: qualification_id

parameters.help_en:
The call mode. Valid values:

roundRobin: round-robin.
random: random
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫模式。取值：

roundRobin：轮询。
random：随机
parameters.name: called_route_mode
